constraints.transactionalFact: The outbox row and owning business fact are committed in one database transaction.
constraints.delivery: Transport adapters may deliver more than once; messageId and idempotencyKey remain stable.
constraints.secrets: Payload contains references only and never resolved credentials.
constraints.messageSize: Envelope + payload must not exceed per-message-type maxSizeBytes limit.
constraints.forbiddenFields: Payload must not contain password, token, kubeconfig, secret, private_key, certificate_key, access_key, or api_key.
